settings.title: What's on the
settings.intro: From world premieres to reimagined classics, our season is built on risk, craft, and the kind of stories you won't see anywhere else in the city.

features.title: The Glass Orchard
features.text: A world premiere about three sisters who inherit a failing orchard and the secrets buried beneath it. A tender, funny, quietly devastating new play.

features.title: Midnight at the Meridian
features.text: A noir revival set in a 1950s hotel lobby where a night clerk, a missing guest, and a suitcase full of letters collide. Style, wit, and a twist you won't see coming.

features.title: The Second Floor
features.text: A devised ensemble piece built from real interviews with the building's former residents — a love letter to the people who lived above the shops.

features.title: Salt & Ash
features.text: A two-hander about a lighthouse keeper and the stranger who washes ashore. Minimal set, maximal feeling — the kind of play that fills a room with silence.

features.title: The Neighborhood Play
features.text: Our annual community production, written and performed with local residents. This year: the story of the warehouse district's own transformation.

features.title: Late-Night Improv
features.text: Every Friday after the show, our resident troupe takes the stage with nothing but a suggestion from the audience. Unscripted, unrepeatable, unmissable.

settings.title: What audiences
settings.intro: From first-timers to season subscribers, here's what people say after the lights come up.

reviews.quote: I came for a date night and left with a new favorite place in the city. The Glass Orchard made me cry in the best way — I've already booked again.
reviews.author: M. Delgado

reviews.quote: The Velvet Curtain is the reason I still believe in live theater. Every production feels hand-made, cared for, and completely alive.
reviews.author: R. Osei

reviews.quote: As a playwright, having a house that will actually stage new work is everything. They took a risk on my play and gave it a home.
reviews.author: J. Whitmore

settings.title: Become a
settings.quote: Membership isn't just a ticket — it's a stake in the kind of theater that takes risks, tells real stories, and keeps the lights on for the neighborhood.

settings.title: Tickets, memberships,
settings.intro: Whether you want tickets, to join the membership, or to bring your own work to our stage, we'd love to hear from you.
